changelog: Added 3D Trunk system with proximity white dot, E key to open/close trunk with animation, and trunk-only visible briefcase (H for weapons) and cloth (K for all other items).
Preserved the classic proximity F2 trunk opener as an independent toggleable module.
Added full in-game configuration in /conf_acn_inventory (3D Trunk tab) with live 3D Raycast/Gizmo placement for default and per-vehicle prop positions.
